client_upgrade.reason: upstream fixes on documented client paths: a Windows shell-builtin path defect that deleted the wrong directory, and two print-mode false-success exits; no NInfer runtime, model or profile change

upstream_fixes.defect: On Windows, shell builtins resolved a drive-relative operand such as `C:` against the OMP process's start directory instead of the shell's working directory; the reported `cd /c/Temp/x && rm -rf C:` recursively deleted the start directory.
upstream_fixes.documented_paths: native Windows x64 client: the RTX 5090 Windows route and both native RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 lanes
upstream_fixes.source_check: crates/pi-vfs/src/path.rs join_path returns base.join(rel) for a host base at v18.10.1; at v18.12.1 it first resolves drive-relative operands through join_drive_relative

upstream_fixes.defect: Print mode returned success after length-stop recovery gave up.
upstream_fixes.documented_paths: every documented `omp -p` command form, whose exit status the acceptance blocks check

upstream_fixes.defect: `omp -p` reported a clean finish with an earlier answer when a context overflow could not be compacted enough to retry.

inclusion_method: GitHub compare of each merge commit against the v18.10.1, v18.12.1 and first-release tags

host_free_checks.asset_identity: omp-darwin-arm64, omp-windows-x64.exe and omp-linux-x64 were downloaded; each SHA-256 and byte count equals the GitHub asset digest and the release SHA256SUMS.txt row recorded in releases/v0.12.2/qualification/client-components.json

loopback_comparison.method: Isolated HOME per binary holding examples/manual-tunnel/models.fragment.yml (endpoint moved to a loopback stub port) and examples/manual-tunnel/fail-closed.yml; the stub emits NInfer-shaped Responses events: reasoning items with summary [] and reasoning_text deltas with explicit content_index, and the full function-call argument snapshot in arguments.done, output_item.done and response.completed.

scenarios.tool_turn: both exit 0; one read call with its linked result; final text OMP_NINFER_TOOL_OK
scenarios.image_input: both exit 0 with one input_image request
scenarios.seed_and_continue: both exit 0; a new process with --continue returned the exact nonce
scenarios.outage: both exit 1 under --max-time 20s with zero requests reaching an endpoint

loopback_comparison.request_differences: user-agent and a 91-character longer instructions string only
loopback_comparison.request_invariants: identical header names and body keys; max_output_tokens 32768; store true; reasoning effort medium; identical input item shapes and tool names; previous_response_id chaining within a process; a cross-process continue replays history with an unchanged prompt_cache_key
absent_on_both: connection warm-up or model-discovery requests to the custom endpoint
loopback_comparison.settings_resolution: retry.enabled false, retry.modelFallback false, retry.fallbackRevertPolicy never, startup.checkUpdate false and providers.maxInFlightRequests resolve identically
loopback_comparison.model_limits: omp models lists ninfer-beta/q38-ninfer with 131K context and 33K max output on both binaries
loopback_comparison.outage_message_change: ECONNREFUSED text became "Couldn't connect to 127.0.0.1:<port> (connection refused)"; no repository script, test or troubleshooting entry matches either text

verdict.scope_limit: The stub reproduces NInfer's documented event shapes, not the NInfer runtime, and only the Darwin binary ran. Live tool, continuation, restart, outage and image-input behavior on the RTX 5090 and native lanes, and the Windows x64 and Linux x64 binaries, remain unproven until the authorized acceptance windows.
